correctness.rationale: The 4-dimensional Einstein curvature operator splits into trace-one self-dual and anti-self-dual 3-by-3 blocks, and the minimum sectional curvature is half the sum of their least eigenvalues. Fresh exact arithmetic verifies the explicit counterexample and the one-parameter family: at t=1/5 the minimum sectional curvature is 1/15 while the three-smallest-eigenvalue sum is -1/15; at t=1/6 they are 1/12 and 0. These identities prove the counterexample and pointwise sharpness directly. The package’s exact certificate source was also inspected.

final_claim: For Einstein algebraic curvature operators in dimension four with Ric=g, positive sectional curvature does not imply 3-positivity, and Wu’s sufficient threshold K>1/12 is sharp at the pointwise algebraic level.
limitations: Pointwise algebraic statement only; no closed Einstein metric realization; closed-manifold target remains open; optimality is over algebraic tensors.
